title: Exact-derived transport of integral units cohomology across the site square
statement: For any scheme morphism f : X → Y and any etale degree-one units cohomology class e, let a : f_proet^* G_m,Y → G_m,X have adjoint the pullback of units along chart projections. Map e to the proetale site with integerComparison.inv and cartierUnitsComparison as endpoints [def-sp-tower-class-reduction]. Then mapping this ordinary derived arrow by f_proet^* and composing with a[1] equals precomposing by the constant-integer comparison and mapping gmCohomologyMap f e to the proetale site with the same endpoints on X. The canonical exact-functor single and shift comparisons are included by mapSingleArrow. This is an equality before passing to constant towers.

proof.text: Apply the two ordinary endpoint squares of lem-sp-integral-site-pullback-endpoints. Exact-functor Ext compatibility for composition and functor isomorphisms identifies the two transports across comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso. Realize in the derived category using mapExactFunctor_hom; naturality of the single and shift comparisons proves compatibility with precomposition and shifted postcomposition. The integer square identifies the source composites and the units square identifies the target composites. Their common composite gives the claimed equality.

theorem integral_cohomology_site_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (e : Sheaf.H Y.gmSheaf 1)
    (a : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u₁ + 1} f).obj (Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf Y) ⟶
      Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf X)
    (ha : ∀ (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf Y).obj.obj U),
      (((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u₁ + 1} f).homEquiv _ _) a).hom.app
          U x = ULift.up (Additive.ofMul
          (Units.map (pullback.fst U.unop.hom f).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom x.down.toMul))) :
    mapSingleArrow (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u₁ + 1} f) 1
        (mapExtensionEndpoints (comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u₁ + 1} Y) e
          (integerComparison Y).inv (cartierUnitsComparison Y)) ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb X) 0).map a)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb X) 0).map
          (((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u₁ + 1} f).homEquiv _ _).symm
            (Scheme.proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap f AddCommGrpCat.{u₁ + 1}
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u₁ + 1} ℤ)))) ≫
        mapExtensionEndpoints (comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u₁ + 1} X)
          (Scheme.gmCohomologyMap f 1 e)
          (integerComparison X).inv (cartierUnitsComparison X)
